name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new roof replacement typically comes with two types of warranties: a material warranty from the manufacturer and a workmanship warranty from the contractor. Material warranties often range from 20 years to lifetime, depending on the product. Our workmanship warranties cover the installation itself, usually for a period of several years. Understanding both types ensures your investment is protected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a material warranty from the manufacturer (20-year to lifetime) and a workmanship warranty from the contractor, covering the installation. Both protect your investment.
